newsitem.title: UK: UK Japan stocks trade higher, Sony gains again.
newsitem.headline: UK Japan stocks trade higher, Sony gains again.

text.p: Japanese shares traded here continued their recent strong run with Sony leading the market again, dealers said.

"People have got the bull market in their teeth but we're seeing some slowing down because people can't resist taking some profits. Sony's still up there and rising and there's still good upside potential for the market," said one trader.
The Nikkei 50 put on 0.77 points to 1,689.24 by 1310 GMT.
Sony was 55 yen higher at 10,700 yen.
Dealers said, however, that banks were seeing some profit-taking.
Fuji Bank fell 15 yen to 1,655 yen and Sumitomo fell 10 yen to 1,880 yen.
